data.cultural_impact: The name "Irme" holds a rich cultural significance, originating from Greek mythology as a form of the river god Irme. This god was often depicted as a peaceful deity, presiding over freshwater sources and maintaining harmony among the land, water, and the people. The name "Irme" thus carries the connotation of tranquility, serenity, and the nurturing elements of water.
data.spiritual_significance: From a Christian perspective, the name "Irme" spiritually symbolizes peace and harmony as given by the Grace of God. In the Bible, Jesus often speaks of perpetual peace: "Peace I leave with you; my peace I give you. I do not give to you as the world gives. Do not let your hearts be troubled and do not be afraid" (John 14:27). Furthermore, the spiritual significance of water in Christianity offers another layer of interpretation to the name, representing the cleansing and renewing power of God's love and forgiveness.
